data.name: Cancel_Confirm_Message
data.value: Cancel the clone? The target disk will be left uninitialized. Your original disk is not modified (if it was shrunk, its size is restored).

data.name: Disks_Subtitle
data.value: Your system disk is the source. Pick the disk that will receive the copy. Everything on the destination disk will be erased.

data.name: Disks_Blocked_Title
data.value: This computer cannot be cloned in this version

data.name: Disks_Blocked_Body
data.value: Fix the reasons below, then press Refresh.

data.name: Disks_Empty_Body
data.value: Connect an internal or USB disk of at least {0}. Everything on it will be erased, so use a disk without important data, then press Refresh.

data.name: Disks_Strategy_Shrink
data.value: Windows on the original disk must be shrunk first

data.name: Disks_Reason_GlobalBlocked
data.value: The checks for this computer failed, so no disk can be used.

data.name: Disks_Select_Hint
data.value: Press Space or Enter to select this disk.

data.name: Preflight_FirmwareNotUefi
data.value: This computer does not start in UEFI mode, so it cannot be cloned in this version.

data.name: Preflight_SourceNotGpt
data.value: The system disk does not use the GPT partition style, which this version requires.

data.name: Preflight_UnsupportedDiskKind
data.value: The system disk uses a storage setup this version does not support, such as dynamic disks, RAID or Storage Spaces.

data.name: Preflight_MultipleWindows
data.value: The system disk does not contain exactly one Windows installation, so there is nothing clear to clone.

data.name: Preflight_TargetIsSystem
data.value: This is the system disk, so it cannot be used as the destination.

data.name: Preflight_TargetInUse
data.value: This disk is in use by Windows or another program. Close the programs that use it or disconnect it, then press Refresh.

data.name: Preflight_TargetTooSmall
data.value: The disk is too small to hold Windows and its data. It needs {0} more. Choose a larger disk.

data.name: Preflight_SectorSizeMismatch
data.value: This disk uses a different sector size than the system disk, and this version cannot clone between them.

data.name: Preflight_ShrinkInsufficient
data.value: Windows cannot be shrunk enough to fit on this disk. Free up space on the system disk or choose a larger disk.

data.name: Preflight_SnapshotUnavailable
data.value: The system cannot create the consistent copy it needs while Windows is running. Check that Volume Shadow Copy is available, then try again.

data.name: Preflight_SnapshotSpaceLow
data.value: The system disk does not have enough free space for the consistent copy. Only {0} is free and at least 2 GiB is needed. Free up space and try again.

data.name: Preflight_BitLockerOn
data.value: BitLocker is on for Windows, so the copy will not be encrypted. To encrypt the new disk again, turn BitLocker on in Windows after cloning.

data.name: Preflight_OnBattery
data.value: This computer is running on battery. Connect the charger before you start so it does not sleep or run out of power during the copy.

data.name: Preflight_TargetNotEmpty
data.value: This disk has partitions or data. Everything on it will be erased.

data.name: Review_Subtitle
data.value: Check what will happen before you continue. No disk is changed yet.

data.name: Review_Failed_Body
data.value: Go back and choose another disk, or fix the reasons below.

data.name: Review_Failed_Generic
data.value: The plan could not be created. Go back and try again.

data.name: Review_VerifyAll
data.value: Verify all data (roughly doubles the duration)

data.name: Confirm_Subtitle
data.value: Nothing has been changed yet. This is the last step where you can stop.

data.name: Confirm_Erase_Warning
data.value: EVERYTHING on this disk will be erased

data.name: Confirm_Prompt_Serial
data.value: Type the last 4 characters of the serial number ({0}) to confirm

data.name: Confirm_Prompt_Guid
data.value: Type the last 4 characters of the disk identifier ({0}) to confirm

data.name: Confirm_Field_Help
data.value: Upper and lower case do not matter. Copy the characters from the disk card above.

data.name: Confirm_CloneNow_Help
data.value: Erases the disk above and starts the clone. Available only when the characters match.

data.name: Confirm_PlanInvalidated
data.value: The disks changed; please review again

data.name: Confirm_Failed
data.value: The confirmation could not be saved. Try again.

data.name: Shrink_Heading
data.value: Temporary shrink of the original disk

data.name: Shrink_Review_Body
data.value: Windows (C:) will go from {0} to {1} during the copy and will be restored when it finishes.

data.name: Shrink_Confirm_Body
data.value: To make it fit, WinCopy will temporarily shrink the Windows partition on the original disk from {0} to {1}. When it finishes, it gives the space back and restores its size. Windows may take several minutes to move files.

data.name: Shrink_Confirm_Understand
data.value: I understand and authorize temporarily shrinking the original disk

data.name: Progress_Subtitle
data.value: Keep the computer plugged in and do not turn it off.

data.name: Progress_Warning_NoChanges
data.value: Changes you make from now on will not be included in the clone

data.name: Phase_Revalidate
data.value: Checking that the disks have not changed

data.name: Phase_ShrinkSource
data.value: Shrinking Windows on the original disk

data.name: Phase_Snapshot
data.value: Creating a consistent copy of the system disk

data.name: Phase_ExpandFileSystem
data.value: Extending Windows to the new space

data.name: Phase_RepairBoot
data.value: Adjusting the clone so it starts

data.name: Phase_StructuralVerification
data.value: Checking the structure of the clone

data.name: Phase_FullVerification
data.value: Comparing all data with the original

data.name: Phase_RestoreSource
data.value: Restoring the size of the original disk

data.name: NextStep_ShutDownAndReplaceDisk
data.value: Shut down the computer, then replace the original disk with the new one.

data.name: NextStep_SelectBootDeviceInFirmware
data.value: Turn the computer on and open the boot menu (usually F12, F8 or Esc, depending on the manufacturer). Choose the new disk. You can also set it as the first boot device in the firmware settings.

data.name: NextStep_ReenableBitLocker
data.value: Turn BitLocker back on in Windows on the new disk, because the copy is not encrypted.

data.name: NextStep_KeepOriginalDiskUntilVerified
data.value: Keep the original disk in a safe place until you have checked that the new disk starts and works.

data.name: Result_Success_Body
data.value: Windows has been copied to the new disk. Follow the steps below to start from it.

data.name: Result_Verification_Passed
data.value: The structure of the new disk matches the plan.

data.name: Result_FullVerification_Failed
data.value: {0} bytes differ from the original. First differing offsets on the new disk: {1}.

data.name: Result_Recovery_Warning
data.value: WinRE could not be configured on the new disk. Windows will still start, but the recovery environment will not work until you enable it. To do it, open a command prompt as administrator and run: reagentc /enable

data.name: Result_Failed_Body
data.value: The destination disk was left unfinished and cannot be used to start Windows. Your original disk is still usable.

data.name: Result_Failed_Generic
data.value: An error stopped the process before it could finish.

data.name: Result_Failed_KeepOriginal
data.value: Keep your original disk as it is and keep using it. Choose another destination disk and try again.

data.name: Result_SourceRestored
data.value: The original disk went back to its original size.

data.name: Result_SourceRestore_Failed
data.value: Windows (C:) could not be returned to its original size. The clone is valid. You can recover the space in Disk Management → right-click C: → Extend Volume.

data.name: Result_Cancelled_Body
data.value: The target disk was left uninitialized and cannot be used to start Windows.

data.name: Result_Cancelled_SourceUntouched
data.value: Your original disk was not modified.

data.name: Result_Export_IncludeInventory
data.value: Include the disk inventory (model, serial number and size)

data.name: Result_Export_Failed
data.value: The log could not be exported: {0}

data.name: Result_OpenFolder_Failed
data.value: The log folder could not be opened: {0}

data.name: Error_Unknown
data.value: An unexpected error happened. Try again. If it happens again, export the log when it is available.

data.name: Error_AccessDenied
data.value: WinCopy does not have permission to use a disk. Run WinCopy as administrator and try again.

data.name: Error_DeviceNotFound
data.value: A disk could not be found. Check that it is still connected, then try again.

data.name: Error_DeviceRemoved
data.value: A disk was disconnected during the copy. Connect it again and start over.

data.name: Error_SourceReadError
data.value: The system disk could not be read. Check it for errors, then try again.

data.name: Error_TargetWriteError
data.value: The destination disk could not be written. Check its connection or use another disk.

data.name: Error_SnapshotFailed
data.value: The consistent copy of the system disk could not be created. Check that Volume Shadow Copy works, then try again.

data.name: Error_ShrinkFailed
data.value: Windows could not be shrunk on the original disk. Restart the computer and try again.

data.name: Error_RestoreFailed
data.value: The original disk could not be restored to its original size. Do not change it, keep the log and ask for help.

data.name: Error_ExtendFailed
data.value: Windows could not use all the new space on the destination disk. Check the log and try again.

data.name: Error_MountFailed
data.value: A partition could not be opened for the copy. Close the programs that use the disks, then try again.

data.name: Error_BootConfigFailed
data.value: The boot settings of the clone could not be adjusted. Do not start from the clone. Try again.

data.name: Error_RecoveryConfigFailed
data.value: WinRE could not be configured on the clone. Windows will still start. Enable WinRE later with reagentc /enable.

data.name: Error_RegistryEditFailed
data.value: The system settings of the clone could not be adjusted. Try again.

data.name: Error_VerificationFailed
data.value: The check of the clone found problems. Do not use the clone until the problems are fixed. Try again.

data.name: Error_TargetInUse
data.value: The destination disk is in use by Windows or another program. Close the programs that use it and try again.

data.name: Error_Cancelled
data.value: The process was cancelled before it finished.

data.name: Error_Unexpected
data.value: An unexpected error stopped the process. Try again. If it happens again, keep the log file: it shows where the process stopped.

data.name: Error_SourceDeviceRemoved
data.value: The system disk was disconnected during the clone. Connect it again, then start over. Keep the log file.

data.name: Error_TargetDeviceRemoved
data.value: The destination disk was disconnected during the clone, so the clone is incomplete. Connect it again and start over.

data.name: Error_DisksChanged
data.value: The disks changed after the plan was made. Plan the clone again.

data.name: Error_ShrinkInsufficient
data.value: Windows cannot be shrunk enough to fit on the target disk. Free up space on the system disk or choose a larger disk.

data.name: Error_ShrinkJournalFailed
data.value: WinCopy could not save the record needed to restore the Windows disk, so it did not shrink it. The original disk was not changed. Restart WinCopy and try again. If it happens again, keep the log file.

data.name: Startup_SourceRestored
data.value: The last clone was interrupted and your Windows disk had been shrunk. WinCopy has restored it to its original size.

data.name: Startup_SourceRestoreNeedsAttention
data.value: The last clone was interrupted and your Windows disk had been shrunk. WinCopy could not restore it automatically. To fix it, open Disk Management, right-click C: and choose Extend Volume.
